title: Kismet
tagline: Artists and collectors converge on kismet to create, collect and curate art
description: The goal of Kismet is to give artists and their collectors provenance, a sustainable way to interact, and a meaningful experience for discovery. There has been a gap in the digital art market that onchain mechanisms can fill. Each Kismet Casa residency we run we create collections with work from each artist in residence and need to be able to service their exact needs.
how_its_made: Kismet is a client of In Process, a ZoraV2 fork. During the hackathon I built agentic collecting allowing users to set parameters for an agent to collect artwork from specified artists. The feature currently works by utilizing Coinbase Developer Platform for spender permissions and paymaster to run a single agent to serve the requests from each user. I have also implemented a per-action collect functions using Base MCP.
